content: Rut ikam uraata isu bali lene ki Boas
Tomtom ta imbotmbot, zaana Boas. Ni ziru Elimelek ta Naomi kusiini na, un tamen. Mi Boas tana, ni mbio uunu, mi ni biibi pa kar Betelem.

Aigule ta na, Rut iso pa Naomi ta kembei: “Koozi tiyembutmbut kini bali. Tana nio leleŋ be aŋla aŋto zin uraata kan. Mi sombe timuŋai yo, nako irao aŋyo kanda bali pakan ta titoptop ma tizem na.” Naomi ipekel Rut kwoono ma iso: “Lutuŋ, ambai. La.”

Tana Rut ipa ma ila pa bali lene ta, mi ila kizin wal uraata kan ma ito zin mi iyyo kana. Mi ni iute som: bali lene tina katuunu asiŋ. Tamen ila indeeŋe kat bali lene ki Boas, ta ziru Elimelek un tamen na.
Molo som na, Boas izem Betelem mi isula be itiiri zin uraata kan. Mi iso pizin ta kembei: “Yooba ko imbotmbot raama yom mi imboro yom.” Zin tipekel kwoono ma tiso: “Yooba ko ikampe u.”
Mi Boas iwi mbesooŋo kini ta imborro zin uraata kan na ma iso: “Ai, so moori kaibiim tiŋga?”
Mbesooŋo tana ipekel kwoono ma iso, “Iŋga Moap nan ta izem lele kini mi ziru Naomi timar na.
Ni iwi yo be aŋyok pini ma ila ito zin uraata kan, mi iyo ka bali pakan ta titoptop zzu toono na. Ta mbeŋbeŋŋana mi imar na, ni inoknok uraata. Ma buri ŋonoono ta keteene isu ri mi imaŋga mini.”
Boas ileŋ to, ila mi iso pa Rut ta kembei: “Lutuŋ moori, leŋ. Kozo la bali lene kizin wal pakan pepe. Mbotmbot men ta ti, mi niomŋan zin moori uraata kan tio kakamam uraata.

Re la pizin uraata kan tio tau. Sombe timaŋga mini pa bali yembutŋana swoi, to nu la ma to zin, mi niomŋan koyyo. Nio aŋkam sua mbolŋana pizin kek be tikam bakai pu pepe. Mi sombe miri u, na la mi win kom yok ta tise sula yok putuunu ma imbotmbot.”
Rut ileŋ sua kini, to ilek kumbuunu, mi ituundu sula toono, mi iso pini ta kembei: “Wai, parei ta nu kam ŋgar biibi pio mi sombe kampe yo ta kembei? Nio iŋgi sa moori ki lele toro na.”

Boas ipekel sua kini ma iso: “Nio aŋleŋ urum kek. Indeeŋe ta kusim imeete ma imar na, nu kampewe kat rwom mooribi. Mi zem tomom ma nom, mi toono ku ma kar ku, mi mar mbot lele tiŋgi ta ute ka tomtom bizin som.
Yooba itunu ko ipokot mbulu ku ambaiŋana ta kamam na. Pa iŋgi mar lele ki Yooba ta Anutu kizin Israel na, be mataana pu mi ikuubukaalu, tana ni ko ikam lem kadoono ambaiŋana mi ikampe u ma biibi.”

Rut ipekel sua ki Boas ma iso ta kembei: “Biibi tio, iŋgi nu kampe yo kat. Nio moori sorokŋoŋ, nio raraate kembei ta zin moori ku uraata kan tiŋga na som. Tamen nu so sua ambaiŋana men pio mi potor leleŋ. Tabe kam ma leleŋ ambai kat.”

Indeeŋe ta zin keten su be tikan kini na, Boas iso pa Rut ta kembei: “A barau, mar ŋana mi kam kom narabu suruunu, mi tizik sula yambon mi kan.” Tana Rut ziŋan zin uraata kan mbulen su, mi Boas ikam bali mazeene pini, mi ni ikam ma ikan ma irao kopoono isaana. Mi kini kalwoono imbotmbot.

Tikan ma imap, tona Rut imiili pa uraata. Mi Boas iur sua pizin uraata kan ta kembei: “Sombe Rut iyogeege bali ta igarau pa bali pezekatŋan na, kumbuulu kwoyom pini pepe. Pa nio aŋyok pini be ikam ta kembei.
Mi bali pezekatŋan tomini, kere be kapas pakan ma isu. Beso imar to iyo kana. Mi motoyom iŋgal: Koyo kwoyom pini pepe.”
Tana Rut iyogeege bali ma irao zoŋ isula. Mi ilup ma indou, to itut, mi ikam ŋonon ma iyo sula kiri.
Tona ikam bali tana mi imiili ma ila kar Betelem, mi iso rwoono mooribi pa. Mi kini mazeene ta ikan ma kalwoono imbotmbot na, ikam la kini tomini.

Tana Naomi iwi i: “Koozi nu yogeege bali swoi? Nu la mi kam uraata pa bali lene ki asiŋ? Tomtom ta ikam mbulu ambaiŋana taiŋgi pu, na Yooba ko ikampe i.” To Rut iso: “Koozi nio aŋkam uraata isu bali lene ki Boas.”

Tona Naomi iso: “Yooba ko ikampe kat Boas! Muŋaiŋana ki Yooba na, imapmap som. Ni mataana iŋgalŋgal zin wal meeteŋan mi iti ta matanda yaryaara i tomini.” Mi Naomi iso mini: “Tomtom tana, ni ziru Elimelek un tamen tau. Tana ni le uraata be iuulu iti pa pataŋana kiti.”
Tona Rut iso mini: “Mi koroŋ toro. Boas iso pio ta kembei: Niamŋan zin moori kini uraata kan irao amkamam uraata ma ila irao bali ka uraata imap.”
Mi Naomi iso pa Rut: “Lutuŋ moori, re. Ina ambai kat. Kozo nu niomŋan zin moori uraata kan ki Boas kakamam uraata su bali lene kini men. Kokena la pa bali lene toro, to ko ndeeŋe pataŋana.”
Tana Rut ziŋan zin moori uraata kan ki Boas tikamam uraata ila mbata ma irao uraata ki bali ma wit yembutŋana imap. Mi indeeŋe mazwaana tana, Rut izem rwoono mooribi som. Ziru timbotmbot men.
